_doc:
Corpus for tools/tests/config-eval.test.mjs. Every expression is evaluated twice:
by PHP 8.3 (fixtures/config-eval/oracle.php) and by the build-time fold (tools/static.mjs).
A folded value must equal PHP exactly - value AND array key order.

"refused" lists the expressions the fold DECLINES, each with (a prefix of) the reason it
prints. Declining is the honest answer for PCRE, the build clock and host-precision cases
(tools/php-funcs.mjs header rule 2). A refusal that is NOT listed fails the test, so
answering `undefined` silently - the bug class that made config values vanish - cannot
come back unnoticed.

"edgeAnswers" lists the expressions where the fold deliberately answers something other
than the build host PHP would, each with the reason and the value it must answer. These are
the ONLY allowed divergences from the oracle: the compiled rung is JavaScript, so a PHP
extension does not exist there (extension_loaded() answers false for every name), and the
folded config is what the WORKER boots with. An entry here is a decision that has to be
kept on purpose - the test fails when the fold's answer changes.

refused.'1_000' + 0: PHP ErrorException: A non-numeric value encountered
refused.'5 apples' + 1: PHP ErrorException: A non-numeric value encountered
refused.str_pad(\"x\", 5, \"\"): str_pad() with an empty pad string is a ValueError in PHP 8
refused.max(1, 2): PHP max(): not implemented — add it to tools/php-funcs.mjs with an oracle test
refused.abs(-3): PHP abs(): not implemented — add it to tools/php-funcs.mjs with an oracle test
refused.round(1.5): PHP round(): PHP's round() has a half-up decimal mode JS does not
refused.strpos(\"abc\", \"b\"): strpos() is not implemented by the build-time config fold (tools/php-funcs.mjs)
refused.array_sum([1, 2]): array_sum() is not implemented by the build-time config fold (tools/php-funcs.mjs)
refused.count([[1, 2]], 1): count() with a mode argument (COUNT_RECURSIVE) is not modelled
refused.array_map(fn($v) => $v, [1], [2]): array_map() over more than one array ZIPS them, which the fold does not model
refused.array_map(\"nope\", [1]): array_map() calls 'nope', a function the build-time fold does not implement (PHP would call the real one)
refused.array_keys([1, 2], 2): array_keys() with a search value is not modelled
refused.array_unique([1, 1], SORT_NUMERIC): argument #2 of array_unique is not statically evaluable, and letting the callee's default parameter stand in f
refused.array_unique([1, 1], 0): array_unique() with a sort flag (SORT_REGULAR/…) is not modelled
refused.json_encode([1], JSON_PRETTY_PRINT): argument #2 of json_encode is not statically evaluable, and letting the callee's default parameter stand in fo
refused.json_encode([1], 0): json_encode() with flags or a depth argument is not modelled (they change the bytes)
refused.json_decode(\"{}\", true, 512): json_decode() with a depth or flags argument is not modelled
refused.ucwords(\"a-b\", \"-\"): ucwords() with its PHP 8 separators argument is not modelled
refused.substr(\"abcdef\", 1, 2, 3): substr() takes three arguments (PHP raises an ArgumentCountError for a fourth)
refused.substr(\"héllo\", 0, 2): the byte slice cuts a UTF-8 sequence in half (PHP strings are bytes; the config dump is JSON text)
refused.implode(\",\", [\"a\"], \"x\"): implode() takes a glue and an array (PHP raises an ArgumentCountError for a third argument)
refused.str_replace(\"a\", \"b\", \"aa\", $n): argument #4 of str_replace is not statically evaluable, and letting the callee's default parameter stand in fo
refused.time(): PHP time(): the value changes on every boot
refused.preg_match(\"/a/\", \"a\"): PHP preg_match(): PCRE and JS RegExp are different engines: a port would silently diverge
refused.sprintf(\"%s\", \"x\"): PHP sprintf(): PHP's format engine is not JS's: a port would silently diverge
refused.__DIR__: magic constant __DIR__ names the build machine's path, which the edge does not have
refused.$undefined: the variable $undefined is never assigned in the file the fold executed
refused.\"abc\" + 1: PHP TypeError: Unsupported operand types: int + string
refused.count(1): count() could not be answered by the fold for these arguments
refused.version_compare(\"8.0\", \"8.1\"): version_compare() is not implemented by the build-time config fold (tools/php-funcs.mjs)
refused.implode(\",\", [0.1 + 0.2]): the float 0.30000000000000004 interpolates as PHP's precision=14 rendering (0.1 + 0.2 is '0.3'), which JS woul
refused.strval(12.5): the float 12.5 interpolates as PHP's precision=14 rendering (0.1 + 0.2 is '0.3'), which JS would print differe
refused.\"a\" . (0.1 + 0.2): the float 0.30000000000000004 interpolates as PHP's precision=14 rendering (0.1 + 0.2 is '0.3'), which JS woul
refused.\"x\" . []: concatenating an array is a PHP warning — an ErrorException under Laravel, i.e. the app does not boot

extension_loaded(\"curl\").why: the compiled rung is JavaScript: no PHP extension exists on the edge, and the folded config is what the worker boots with (tools/php-funcs.mjs EDGE_EXTENSIONS)

extension_loaded(\"pcre\").why: the compiled rung is JavaScript: no PHP extension exists on the edge, and the folded config is what the worker boots with (tools/php-funcs.mjs EDGE_EXTENSIONS)
